response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS st, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS a FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS o FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), st_avg AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE st IS NOT NULL AND a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st) SELECT AVG(sv.a) AS avg_face_count, AVG(sv.a - o.o) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(sv.a - t.sa) AS avg_above_status FROM site_avg sv JOIN st_avg t ON t.st = sv.st CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE sv.a > t.sa AND o.o IS NOT NULL
